title: 17th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/17/2024).
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Maldives Legal Profession Act (Law No. 5/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé North MP Hussain Shareef.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Manadhoo MP Husnee Mubarik.

Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act (Law No. 2/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.

Committee business: report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's request for Majlis consent for the Maldives to join the Treaty between the Maldives and Sri Lanka on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters.
Committee business: report of the Public Finance Committee on the matter of advising the President on removing the Governor of the Maldives Monetary Authority from office.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting opened debate on the Legal Profession Act amendment, continued two criminal-justice bills, and took up committee reports on the Sri Lanka legal-assistance treaty and on removing the MMA Governor.
